cleavage agent: Trypsin digestion was carried using TPCK treated trypsin (1: 20) for 12–16 h at 37 °C.
collision energy: MS/MS fragmentation using higher-energy collision dissociation mode at 45% normalized collision energy
enrichment method: We employed tandem mass tag (TMT)-based labeling technology coupled with anti-phosphotyrosine antibody-based enrichment approach
fragmentation method: MS/MS fragmentation using higher-energy collision dissociation mode
instrument: LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer interfaced with Proxeon Easy nLC system
labeling: Peptide samples were labeled using TMT 10 plex reagents
